scope: Editorial district research from previously sourced Census ACS, Census Gazetteer, historic MEDSL returns, 2024 certified finalists, certified 2026 ballot records and individually audited boundaries; not a forecast

guidance.history: Election results follow the district boundaries in force for each listed year. The 2012–2020 and 2022–2024 map vintages must not be treated as continuous boundaries.
guidance.census: 2020–2024 ACS 5-year estimates use 119th Congress geography; rank is among House districts and does not describe or predict 2026 election outcomes.
guidance.communities: Only verified Census reference points within district polygons, not a list of largest places or an assertion all municipality land is in the district.
guidance.rankings: District rankings are descending by ACS reported estimate, unweighted by population, with ties sharing a rank.
